scope: Any character already assigned a Bathroom visit. This contract does not add or change visit eligibility.

sequence.movement: normal routed movement to the existing toilet approach/seat attachment
sequence.layering: While traversing Bathroom A1 or A2, draw the actor behind both the toilet and sink.

sequence.entryCondition: route arrival at the toilet attachment
sequence.pose: existing static seated pose facing south
sequence.layering: draw actor in front of the toilet

sequence.movement: normal routed movement from the toilet attachment to the existing sink approach/use attachment
sequence.layering: While traversing Bathroom A1 or A2, draw the actor behind both the toilet and sink.

sequence.entryCondition: route arrival at the sink attachment
sequence.pose: existing static standing/idle pose facing north
sequence.layering: draw actor in front of the sink

sequence.result: return control to the caller's normal post-visit behavior

runtimeIntegrationNotes.domain: FounderActivityState currently has only kind visit_bathroom plus one route and workMinutesRemaining; it needs ordered visit phase/attachment data without changing eligibility.
runtimeIntegrationNotes.timing: advanceFounderActivity already avoids decrementing workMinutesRemaining until pathIndex reaches the final node; two separate arrived-use timers are required.
runtimeIntegrationNotes.viewModel: Current founder seated derivation excludes visit_bathroom, so it needs an explicit phase-to-pose and cardinal-facing mapping.
runtimeIntegrationNotes.renderer: FacilityScene currently derives founder furniture pose only for Front Desk and depths characters from baseY. Bathroom use requires a narrow relevant-fixture front-layer override while preserving normal A1/A2 walking occlusion.
runtimeIntegrationNotes.art: Reuse existing seated/front (south) and idle/back (north) character statics. No new animation or raster asset is authorized.
